sections.text:
Rename PyPI package exfer-walletd → exfer (0.10.0)
In exfer-stack/exfer-py, his own repository.
https://github.com/exfer-stack/exfer-py/pull/3

## What

Rename the PyPI distribution + import package `exfer-walletd` → `exfer`. The old name collided with the Rust daemon — `pip install exfer-walletd` looked like it installed the daemon, not this client.

```bash
pip install exfer
```
```python
from exfer import Client, AsyncClient
```

## Already published

`exfer 0.10.0` is **live on PyPI**: https://pypi.org/project/exfer/0.10.0/ (built from this branch, install verified). Merging brings `main` in line with what's published.

## Scope

- `src/exfer_walletd/` → `src/exfer/` (git rename), all imports + docstrings updated
- User-Agent `exfer-walletd-py` → `exfer-py`
- pyproject name, README, full `docs/`, CHANGELOG (0.10.0 entry)
- release.yml trusted-publishing note corrected (pending-publisher flow)
- **Unchanged**: every reference to the *daemon* — datadir `~/.exfer-walletd`, repo URLs, integration-test binary, upstream source paths

## Verification

172 unit tests · ruff check · ruff format --check · mypy · twine check — all pass. `pip install exfer` from PyPI verified.

## Follow-up (manual, web UI only)

- Yank old `exfer-walletd` 0.8.0/0.9.0 on PyPI
- Optionally configure project-level trusted publishing now that `exfer` exists
